## Supported Events

`on` and `once` support every event below. `waitFor` excludes packet events.

See `ScriptEventMap` for the full event-name-to-payload map.

| Event | `on` / `once` | `waitFor` | Payload |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `packetFromClient` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> |  | `string` |
| `packetFromServer` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> |  | `string` |
| `extensionResponse` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> |  | `string` |
| `monsterDeath` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `ScriptEventMonsterDeathEvent` |
| `questComplete` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `ScriptEventQuestCompleteEvent` |
| `zone` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `ScriptEventZoneEvent` |
| `joinMap` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `ScriptEventJoinMapEvent` |
| `updateMessage` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `ScriptEventUpdateMessageEvent` |
| `auraAdded` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `ScriptEventAuraEvent` |
| `auraRemoved` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `Omit<ScriptEventAuraEvent, "aura">` |
| `afk` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `ScriptEventAfkEvent` |
| `antiCounterStart` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `ScriptEventAntiCounterEvent` |
| `antiCounterEnd` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `Omit<ScriptEventAntiCounterEvent, "durationMs">` |
| `playerDeath` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `ScriptEventPlayerDeathEvent` |
| `playerLocation` | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | <span class="required-mark" role="img" aria-label="Required"></span> | `ScriptEventPlayerLocationEvent` |
